notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific facts come from one tnlandforms row (county, elevation, coordinates) and its tag 'gfc-126'; the list does not explain the tag, and the brief reads it as GFC US 126. Two searches found no construction, staffing, fire or current-status source. The central_us_lookouts cache file named kildare.html is a Texas lookout (Kildare, Texas) and was not used. A search snippet about a 1909 railroad stop was not used because the Georgia Coast Atlas page did not load. A 2026 brush fire on Clyo-Kildare Road came up in search and is unrelated to the tower, so it was left out. Elevation column read as feet, consistent with the brief's 38.4 m.
